doc:
`roots p` noncomputably gives a multiset containing all the roots of `p`,
including their multiplicities.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDomain R] → Polynomial R → Multiset R

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] (p : Polynomial R)
  [inst_3 : Decidable (p = 0)], p.roots = if h : p = 0 then ∅ else Classical.choose ⋯
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R], Polynomial.roots 0 = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → ↑p.roots.card ≤ p.degree
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R), p.roots.card ≤ p.natDegree

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {a : R},
  0 < p.degree → ↑(p - Polynomial.C a).roots.card ≤ p.degree

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {a : R},
  0 < p.degree → (p - Polynomial.C a).roots.card ≤ p.natDegree

∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] (p : Polynomial R),
  Multiset.count a p.roots = Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, a ∈ p.roots ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ p.IsRoot a
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → (a ∈ p.roots ↔ p.IsRoot a)
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, a ∈ p.roots → p ≠ 0
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, a ∈ p.roots → p.IsRoot a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p ≠ 0 → (p.roots = 0 ↔ ∀ (x : R), ¬p.IsRoot x)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p.roots = 0 ↔ p = 0 ∨ ∀ (x : R), ¬p.IsRoot x
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.roots ≠ 0 ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ x, p.IsRoot x
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.roots ≠ 0 → ∃ x, p.IsRoot x
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → (p.roots ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x, p.IsRoot x)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {x : R},
  p ≠ 0 → (x ∈ p.roots ↔ (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {Z : Finset R},
  Z.val ⊆ p.roots → Z.card ≤ p.natDegree
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → {x | p.IsRoot x}.Finite

doc: Nonzero polynomials have no roots away from a finite set.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ (x : R) in Filter.cofinite, ¬p.IsRoot x

doc: Nonzero polynomials are nonzero away from a finite set.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ (x : R) in Filter.cofinite, Polynomial.eval x p ≠ 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R), {x | p.IsRoot x}.Infinite → p = 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : LinearOrder R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p ≠ 0 → ∃ x₀, ∀ (x : R), p.IsRoot x → x ≤ x₀

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : LinearOrder R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p ≠ 0 → ∃ x₀, ∀ (x : R), p.IsRoot x → x₀ ≤ x

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p q : Polynomial R),
  {x | Polynomial.eval x p = Polynomial.eval x q}.Infinite → p = q

doc: Non-constant polynomials have finite fibres, provided the coefficients are a domain.
statement:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p.natDegree ≠ 0 → Filter.TendstoCofinite fun x => Polynomial.eval x p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p * q ≠ 0 → (p * q).roots = p.roots + q.roots
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p q : Polynomial R}, q ≠ 0 → p ∣ q → p.roots ≤ q.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {a x : R},
  x ∈ (p - Polynomial.C a).roots ↔ p ≠ Polynomial.C a ∧ Polynomial.eval x p = a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {a x : R},
  0 < p.degree → (x ∈ (p - Polynomial.C a).roots ↔ Polynomial.eval x p = a)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (r : R), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r).roots = {r}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (r : R), (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r).roots = {-r}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R], Polynomial.X.roots = {0}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (x : R), (Polynomial.C x).roots = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R], Polynomial.roots 1 = ∅

∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R),
  a ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C a * p).roots = p.roots
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p q : Polynomial R}, Associated p q → p.roots = q.roots
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R), a ≠ 0 → (a • p).roots = p.roots
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R), (-p).roots = p.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R) (a b : R),
  IsUnit a → Multiset.map (fun x => a * x + b) (p.comp (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C b)).roots = p.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R) (a b : R),
  IsUnit a →
    (p.comp (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C b)).roots =
      Multiset.map (fun x => Ring.inverse a * (x - b)) p.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R),
  (p.comp (-Polynomial.X)).roots = Multiset.map (fun x => -x) p.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (b : R) (a : Rˣ),
  (Polynomial.C ↑a * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C b).roots = {↑a⁻¹ * b}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (b : R) (a : Rˣ),
  (Polynomial.C ↑a * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C b).roots = {-(↑a⁻¹ * b)}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (L : List (Polynomial R)),
  0 ∉ L → L.prod.roots = (↑L).bind Polynomial.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (m : Multiset (Polynomial R)),
  0 ∉ m → m.prod.roots = m.bind Polynomial.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {ι : Type u_1} (f : ι → Polynomial R) (s : Finset ι),
  s.prod f ≠ 0 → (s.prod f).roots = s.val.bind fun i => (f i).roots
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (p ^ n).roots = n • p.roots
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.X ^ n).roots = n • {0}

∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R],
  a ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n).roots = n • {0}

∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R],
  a ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), ((Polynomial.monomial n) a).roots = n • {0}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (s : Finset R),
  (∏ a ∈ s, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)).roots = s.val

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (s : Multiset R),
  (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) s).prod.roots = s
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (s : Multiset R), (Polynomial.ofMultiset s).roots = s

∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R],
  Function.RightInverse (⇑Polynomial.ofMultiset) Polynomial.roots
∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R], Function.Injective ⇑Polynomial.ofMultiset

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {n : ℕ},
  0 < n → ∀ (a : R), (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C a).roots.card ≤ n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {S : Finset R},
  (∀ x ∈ S, Polynomial.eval x p = 0) → p.degree ≤ ↑S.card → p ≠ 0 → p.roots = S.val

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {S : Finset R},
  (∀ x ∈ S, Polynomial.eval x p = 0) → ↑S.card = p.degree → p.roots = S.val

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} {S : Finset R},
  (∀ x ∈ S, Polynomial.eval x p = 0) → p.natDegree ≤ S.card → p ≠ 0 → p.roots = S.val

doc: `nthRoots n a` noncomputably returns the solutions to `x ^ n = a`.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDomain R] → ℕ → R → Multiset R

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {n : ℕ},
  0 < n → ∀ {a x : R}, x ∈ Polynomial.nthRoots n a ↔ x ^ n = a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (r : R), Polynomial.nthRoots 0 r = 0
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (n : ℕ), Polynomial.nthRoots n 0 = Multiset.replicate n 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (n : ℕ) (a : R), (Polynomial.nthRoots n a).card ≤ n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {r : R}, Polynomial.nthRoots 2 r = 0 ↔ ¬IsSquare r

doc:
The multiset `nthRoots ↑n a` as a Finset. Previously `nthRootsFinset n` was defined to be
`nthRoots n (1 : R)` as a Finset. That situation can be recovered by setting `a` to be `(1 : R)`
statement: ℕ → {R : Type u_1} → R → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDomain R] → Finset R

∀ (n : ℕ) {R : Type u_1} (a : R) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R],
  Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n a = (Polynomial.nthRoots n a).toFinset

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {n : ℕ},
  0 < n → ∀ (a : R) {x : R}, x ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n a ↔ x ^ n = a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (a : R), Polynomial.nthRootsFinset 0 a = ∅

∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {S : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst_2 : CommRing S]
  [inst_3 : IsDomain S] [inst_4 : FunLike F R S] [MonoidHomClass F R S] {a x : R},
  x ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n a → ∀ (f : F), f x ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n (f a)

∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {S : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst_2 : CommRing S]
  [inst_3 : IsDomain S] [inst_4 : FunLike F R S] [RingHomClass F R S] {x : R},
  x ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n 1 → ∀ (f : F), f x ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n 1

∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {η₁ η₂ a₁ a₂ : R},
  η₁ ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n a₁ →
    η₂ ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n a₂ → η₁ * η₂ ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n (a₁ * a₂)

∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {η a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → η ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n a → η ≠ 0
∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R], 0 < n → 1 ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n 1
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R], Polynomial.nthRoots 2 1 = {-1, 1}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Infinite R] (p : Polynomial R),
  (∀ (x : R), Polynomial.eval x p = 0) → p = 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Infinite R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  (∀ (r : R), Polynomial.eval r p = Polynomial.eval r q) → p = q

doc:
Given a polynomial `p` with coefficients in a ring `T` and a `T`-algebra `S`, `aroots p S` is
the multiset of roots of `p` regarded as a polynomial over `S`.
statement:
{T : Type w} →
  [inst : CommRing T] →
    Polynomial T → (S : Type u_1) → [inst_1 : CommRing S] → [IsDomain S] → [Algebra T S] → Multiset S

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] (p : Polynomial T) (S : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra T S], p.aroots S = (Polynomial.map (algebraMap T S) p).roots

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S]
  {p : Polynomial T} {a : S}, a ∈ p.aroots S ↔ Polynomial.map (algebraMap T S) p ≠ 0 ∧ (Polynomial.aeval a) p = 0

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [Module.IsTorsionFree T S] {p : Polynomial T} {a : S},
  a ∈ p.aroots S ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ (Polynomial.aeval a) p = 0

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [Module.IsTorsionFree T S] {p q : Polynomial T},
  p * q ≠ 0 → (p * q).aroots S = p.aroots S + q.aroots S

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S]
  (r : T), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r).aroots S = {(algebraMap T S) r}

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S],
  Polynomial.X.aroots S = {0}

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S]
  (a : T), (Polynomial.C a).aroots S = 0

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] (S : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S],
  Polynomial.aroots 0 S = 0

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S],
  Polynomial.aroots 1 S = 0

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S]
  (p : Polynomial T), (-p).aroots S = p.aroots S

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [Module.IsTorsionFree T S] {a : T} (p : Polynomial T),
  a ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C a * p).aroots S = p.aroots S

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [Module.IsTorsionFree T S] {a : T} (p : Polynomial T), a ≠ 0 → (a • p).aroots S = p.aroots S

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S]
  (p : Polynomial T) (n : ℕ), (p ^ n).aroots S = n • p.aroots S

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S]
  (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.X ^ n).aroots S = n • {0}

∀ (R : Type u) (S : Type v) {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing T]
  (p : Polynomial T) [inst_3 : CommRing S] [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [inst_5 : Algebra S R] [inst_6 : Algebra T R]
  [IsScalarTower T S R], (Polynomial.map (algebraMap T S) p).aroots R = p.aroots R

doc:
The set of distinct roots of `p` in `S`.

If you have a non-separable polynomial, use `Polynomial.aroots` for the multiset
where multiple roots have the appropriate multiplicity.
statement:
{T : Type w} →
  [inst : CommRing T] → Polynomial T → (S : Type u_1) → [inst_1 : CommRing S] → [IsDomain S] → [Algebra T S] → Set S

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] (p : Polynomial T) (S : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra T S] [inst_4 : DecidableEq S], p.rootSet S = ↑(p.aroots S).toFinset

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S]
  (a : T), (Polynomial.C a).rootSet S = ∅

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] (S : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S],
  Polynomial.rootSet 0 S = ∅

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] (S : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S],
  Polynomial.rootSet 1 S = ∅

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] (p : Polynomial T) (S : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra T S], (-p).rootSet S = p.rootSet S

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] (p : Polynomial T) (S : Type u_1) [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra T S], (p.rootSet S).Finite

∀ (R : Type u) {S : Type v} (T : Type w) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing T]
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] (p : Polynomial S) [inst_4 : Algebra S T] [inst_5 : Algebra T R] [inst_6 : Algebra S R]
  [IsScalarTower S T R], (Polynomial.map (algebraMap S T) p).rootSet R = p.rootSet R

doc:
The set of roots of all polynomials of bounded degree and having coefficients in a finite set
is finite.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : DecidableEq S]
  (m : R →+* S) (d : ℕ) {U : Set R},
  U.Finite → (⋃ f, ⋃ (_ : f.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), f.coeff i ∈ U), ↑(Polynomial.map m f).roots.toFinset).Finite

doc:
A version of `mem_rootSet` that requires the polynomial to be non-zero after mapping
instead of requiring it to be non-zero and `Module.IsTorsionFree`.
statement:
∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T} {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra T S] {a : S}, a ∈ p.rootSet S ↔ Polynomial.map (algebraMap T S) p ≠ 0 ∧ (Polynomial.aeval a) p = 0

doc:
A version of `mem_rootSet'` that requires `Module.IsTorsionFree` and for the polynomial to be
non-zero instead of requiring it to be non-zero after mapping.
statement:
∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T} {S : Type u_1} [IsDomain T] [inst_2 : CommRing S]
  [inst_3 : IsDomain S] [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [Module.IsTorsionFree T S] {a : S},
  a ∈ p.rootSet S ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ (Polynomial.aeval a) p = 0

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T} {S : Type u_1} [IsDomain T] [inst_2 : CommRing S]
  [inst_3 : IsDomain S] [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [Module.IsTorsionFree T S],
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ {a : S}, a ∈ p.rootSet S ↔ (Polynomial.aeval a) p = 0

∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p ≠ Polynomial.C a → (fun x => Polynomial.eval x p) ⁻¹' {a} = (p - Polynomial.C a).rootSet R

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T},
  p.Monic →
    ∀ {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S] {a : S},
      a ∈ p.rootSet S ↔ (Polynomial.aeval a) p = 0

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T} {S : Type u_1} {S' : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : IsDomain S] [inst_3 : Algebra T S] [inst_4 : CommRing S'] [inst_5 : IsDomain S'] [inst_6 : Algebra T S'],
  (Polynomial.map (algebraMap T S') p = 0 → Polynomial.map (algebraMap T S) p = 0) →
    ∀ (f : S →ₐ[T] S'), Set.MapsTo (⇑f) (p.rootSet S) (p.rootSet S')

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra T S] {a : S}, a ∈ p.rootSet S → p ≠ 0

∀ {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra T S] {a : S}, a ∈ p.rootSet S → (Polynomial.aeval a) p = 0

∀ {T : Type w} [inst : CommRing T] {p : Polynomial T} [IsDomain T] {S : Type u_1} {S' : Type u_2} [inst_2 : CommRing S]
  [inst_3 : IsDomain S] [inst_4 : Algebra T S] [inst_5 : CommRing S'] [inst_6 : IsDomain S'] [inst_7 : Algebra T S']
  [Module.IsTorsionFree T S'] (f : S →ₐ[T] S'), Set.MapsTo (⇑f) (p.rootSet S) (p.rootSet S')

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {n : ℕ},
  0 < n → ∀ (a : R), ↑(Polynomial.nthRootsFinset n a) = {r | r ^ n = a}

∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : Algebra S R]
  {G : Type u_1} [inst_4 : Monoid G] [inst_5 : MulSemiringAction G R] [SMulCommClass G S R] {f : Polynomial S} (g : G)
  {x : R}, x ∈ f.rootSet R → g • x ∈ f.rootSet R

∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : Algebra S R]
  {G : Type u_1} [inst_4 : Monoid G] [inst_5 : MulSemiringAction G R] [SMulCommClass G S R] {f : Polynomial S} {g : G},
  IsUnit g → ∀ {x : R}, g • x ∈ f.rootSet R ↔ x ∈ f.rootSet R

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R) {ι : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype ι] {f : ι → R},
  Function.Injective f → (∀ (i : ι), Polynomial.eval (f i) p = 0) → p.natDegree < Fintype.card ι → p = 0

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p q : Polynomial R) {ι : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype ι] {f : ι → R},
  Function.Injective f →
    (∀ (i : ι), Polynomial.eval (f i) p = Polynomial.eval (f i) q) →
      max p.natDegree q.natDegree < Fintype.card ι → p = q

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R) (s : Finset R),
  (∀ i ∈ s, Polynomial.eval i p = 0) → p.natDegree < s.card → p = 0

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p q : Polynomial R) (s : Finset R),
  (∀ i ∈ s, Polynomial.eval i p = Polynomial.eval i q) → max p.natDegree q.natDegree < s.card → p = q

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (f : Polynomial R),
  (∀ (r : R), Polynomial.eval r f = 0) → ↑f.natDegree < Cardinal.mk R → f = 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (f : Polynomial R),
  f ≠ 0 → ↑f.natDegree < Cardinal.mk R → ∃ r, Polynomial.eval r f ≠ 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (s : Multiset R),
  (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) s).prod.Monic

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {α : Type u_1} (b : α → R) (s : Finset α),
  (∏ a ∈ s, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (b a))).Monic
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {α : Type u_1} (b : α → R), (∏ᶠ (k : α), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (b k))).Monic

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} [inst_2 : DecidableEq R],
  (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod =
    ∏ a ∈ p.roots.toFinset, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p

doc: The product `∏ (X - a)` for `a` inside the multiset `p.roots` divides `p`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R),
  (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod ∣ p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (s : Multiset R), (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) s).prod ∣ p ↔ s ≤ p.roots

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R),
  ∃ q,
    (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod * q = p ∧
      p.roots.card + q.natDegree = p.natDegree ∧ q.roots = 0

doc:
A polynomial `p` that has as many roots as its degree
can be written `p = p.leadingCoeff * ∏(X - a)`, for `a` in `p.roots`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p.roots.card = p.natDegree →
    Polynomial.C p.leadingCoeff * (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod = p

doc:
A monic polynomial `p` that has as many roots as its degree
can be written `p = ∏(X - a)`, for `a` in `p.roots`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p.Monic → p.roots.card = p.natDegree → (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod = p
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {a p : Polynomial R}, p.Monic → a ∣ p → IsUnit a.leadingCoeff
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, Irreducible p → p.roots.card ≤ 1

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  Irreducible p → p.natDegree ≠ 1 → p.roots = 0

doc:
To check a monic polynomial is irreducible, it suffices to check only for
divisors that have smaller degree.

See also: `Polynomial.Monic.irreducible_iff_natDegree`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p.Monic → p ≠ 1 → (Irreducible p ↔ ∀ (q : Polynomial R), q.degree ≤ ↑(p.natDegree / 2) → q ∣ p → IsUnit q)

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] {p : Polynomial A} {f : A →+* B},
  Polynomial.map f p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (a : A), Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p ≤ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (f a) (Polynomial.map f p)

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] {p : Polynomial A} {f : A →+* B},
  Function.Injective ⇑f →
    ∀ (a : A), Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p = Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (f a) (Polynomial.map f p)

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B]
  {p : Polynomial A} {f : A →+* B},
  Polynomial.map f p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (b : B), Multiset.count b (Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots) ≤ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity b (Polynomial.map f p)

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B]
  (p : Polynomial A) {f : A →+* B},
  Function.Injective ⇑f →
    ∀ (b : B), Multiset.count b (Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots) ≤ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity b (Polynomial.map f p)

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  {p : Polynomial A} {f : A →+* B}, Polynomial.map f p ≠ 0 → Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots ≤ (Polynomial.map f p).roots

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  (p : Polynomial A) {f : A →+* B}, Function.Injective ⇑f → Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots ≤ (Polynomial.map f p).roots

∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain B] {f : A →+* B}
  (p : Polynomial A), p ≠ 0 → ↑(Polynomial.map f p).roots.card ≤ p.degree

∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain B] {f : A →+* B}
  (p : Polynomial A), (Polynomial.map f p).roots.card ≤ p.natDegree

∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] (p : Polynomial A) (B : Type u_3) [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra A B], (p.rootSet B).ncard ≤ p.natDegree

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  {f : A →+* B} [inst_4 : DecidablePred fun x => x ∈ f.range],
  Function.Injective ⇑f →
    ∀ (p : Polynomial A), Multiset.filter (fun x => x ∈ f.range) (Polynomial.map f p).roots = Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  {p : Polynomial A} {f : A →+* B}, Polynomial.map f p ≠ 0 → p.roots.card ≤ (Polynomial.map f p).roots.card

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  {p : Polynomial A} {f : A →+* B}, Function.Injective ⇑f → p.roots.card ≤ (Polynomial.map f p).roots.card

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  {p : Polynomial A} {f : A →+* B},
  Function.Injective ⇑f → p.roots.card = p.natDegree → Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots = (Polynomial.map f p).roots

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  {p : Polynomial A} (f : A →+* B),
  Polynomial.map f p ≠ 0 → p.roots.card = p.natDegree → Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots = (Polynomial.map f p).roots

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : IsDomain A] [inst_3 : IsDomain B]
  {p : Polynomial A},
  p.Monic → ∀ (f : A →+* B), p.roots.card = p.natDegree → Multiset.map (⇑f) p.roots = (Polynomial.map f p).roots
